snippet.title: Pin A Million - Steam Trailer (Wishlist)
snippet.description:
Pin A Million is a solo-developed pinball roguelite featuring 30+ unique pegs, 41 fusion recipes across 3 tiers, and a dynamic 4-weather system layered with an 8-phase day/moon cycle.

Combine pegs into powerful fusions — from elemental golems to legendary effects like GOD MODE or Galaxy Brain. Unlock 20+ permanent meta-upgrades, play minigames like Spaceship, Pac-Man, Space Invader, and Breakout, and spin the Wheel of Fortune or Slot Machine for extra rewards.

🎮 Playtest live now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5012230/Pin_A_Million/

Feedback is always welcome!

🔗 Follow for updates:
